findings.text: _write_json_atomically re-implements the repository's own atomic JSON publisher reckon/_store.py:521 (write_json_atomically, wrapping write_atomically at :470), whose docstring states it is "the one place a file is published through a sibling temporary ... rather than keeping a private temporary-and-rename beside it"; run_paths.py already imports _config_home from reckon._store, so the private sibling-and-rename could have imported the owner rather than restating it. The behaviour is correct, so this does not hold the node, but it forks a capability the repository already owns.
